description: This file defines a React client component 'SearchPage' that handles video search functionality, including querying an API, managing search state, rendering video results, handling loading and error states, and supporting pagination.

methods.name: SearchPage
methods.description: Main React component that manages the video search interface, including fetching data, rendering results, and user interactions.
